remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.consequence: {name} is signed out on their next request and disappears from the marketplace, but nothing is deleted: the conversations and access requests they are part of stay whole for the people on the other side of them. You can reinstate the account later.

assets.ownerNotActive: Owner not active, so hidden from the catalog

approve.title: Publish {ref}?
approve.consequence: The listing goes into the public catalog immediately and buyers can start requesting its confidential pack. Your note goes to the moderation log, not to the seller.
approve.consequenceOwnerNotActive: The listing is approved, but it stays out of the public catalog while its seller's account is not active: a listing needs both. Reinstate the seller on the Participants tab to make it visible. Your note goes to the moderation log, not to the seller.

reject.title: Reject {ref}?
reject.consequence: The listing stays off the catalog and goes back to the seller, who reads your reason word for word on their dashboard. Write it for them.

suspend.title: Suspend {ref}?
suspend.consequence: The listing leaves the public catalog immediately. The seller sees the new status but not your reason, which only the moderation log holds.
